FROM player_stats ps
JOIN Player p ON ps.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE (ps.result = 'win' AND ps.match_count = (SELECT MAX(match_count) FROM player_stats WHERE result = 'win'))
   OR (ps.result = 'loss' AND ps.match_count = (SELECT MAX(match_count) FROM player_stats WHERE result = 'loss'))
ORDER BY ps.result, ps.match_count DESC
